original: WPRPLACE, or Hecla, is an active stratovolcano in the south of Iceland with a height of 1,491 m . WPRPLACE is one of Iceland's most active volcanoes; over 20 eruptions have occurred in and around the volcano since the year 1210. During the Middle Ages, the Icelandic Norse called the volcano the "Gateway to Hell" and the idea spread over much of Europe.
